messages:
alexa_morris: Hey team — promo code `REDWOOD50D` was redeemed during checkout but the credit landed on our Hosted usage instead of the Dedicated reservation SKU. We purchased a Dedicated monthly commit (order DED-8421) last night. Can someone move the credit or refund+reapply? Screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/ord-DED-8421.png

matt_support: sorry about that, that must be annoying. quick question: did you redeem the code from the dedicated checkout page or the general billing portal?

alexa_morris: I grabbed it from the invoice email redeem link. It showed a confirm modal that mentioned "apply to account" only, no SKU selection. I assumed it would attach to the most recent charge (the Dedicated commit).

matt_support: thanks. I can see the promo code in our backend — looks like it was created as a Hosted credit (promo.type=usage_hosted). tagging billing: @julie_billing can we reassign or issue a targeted credit to the Dedicated SKU?

billing-bot: New billing task created: BLG-2026-1147 assigned to julie_billing. Event: promo_redeem by org-org_7a2f.
julie_billing: taking this. confirmed: promo REDWOOD50D applied as a hosted-credit (amount $5,000). Dedicated commits are handled as invoice/commit credits and need a different allocation. Two options: 1) issue a refund of the hosted credit and reissue a Dedicated-targeted credit, or 2) carve out an internal transfer to the Dedicated commit balance. Which do you prefer?

alexa_morris: Prefer option 2 if possible — we don't want to disrupt invoices. But if transfer isn't possible, do refund+reapply quickly so we hit the reserved capacity before monthly run.

sam_ops: quick note: technically the Dedicated SKU ledger is separate (ledger:dedi_commits). Transfers are allowed but require finance approval because of revenue recognition. I'll prep the journal entry if billing approves.

julie_billing: finance ok with transfer for this case, we just need a confirmation from the customer to proceed. @alexa_morris can you confirm you authorize transfer of the $5,000 hosted promo credit to Dedicated commit ledger for org-org_7a2f?

alexa_morris: Confirmed. Please go ahead. Also can you add a note to prevent the checkout link from defaulting to Hosted for dedicated orders? That caused the confusion.

matt_support: noted re: UX. I'll file a small product issue after this. For tracking, i'll run the remediation steps now: 1) revoke hosted credit id `cred_h_9b2f`, 2) create dedicated credit `cred_d_5a7c` scoped to order DED-8421, 3) attach to commit ledger. Executing and will post logs.

matt_support: logs: ```
# revoke
POST /internal/billing/credits/revoke cred_h_9b2f -> 200 OK
# create
POST /internal/billing/credits create {"org":"org_7a2f","amount":500000,"currency":"USD","scope":"dedicated_commit","order":"DED-8421"} -> id=cred_d_5a7c
# attach
POST /internal/billing/ledger/attach ledger:dedi_commits attach cred_d_5a7c -> 200 OK
```

julie_billing: done on our side, BLG-2026-1147 updated to status: completed. Credit `cred_d_5a7c` now shows on the Dedicated ledger. Alexa, you should see the Dedicated reservation reflect the credit in the console under Billing -> Reserved Capacity -> Invoice DED-8421.

alexa_morris: I can see it, thanks! Shows $5,000 applied. Huge help. Please leave BLG ticket open until the month close, we want to confirm usage draws from the reserved credit. :thumbsup:

sam_ops: noted, monitoring enabled for the next billing cycle to ensure consumption comes off the commit ledger. I set an alert if Hosted credits are used unexpectedly.

carmen_account: adding a follow-up: I've applied a one-time goodwill hosted credit of $250 to make up for the friction. Should be visible in Hosted balance. Sorry for the confusion — we'll update the redeem flow text to clarify Dedicated vs Hosted promo codes.

alexa_morris: thanks everyone, appreciate the speedy turnaround :raised_hands:
